title: bp appoints ian tyler chairman board 2026 09 02
text:
Sept 2 (Reuters) - BP (BP.L)
, opens new tab
 has appointed ​Ian Tyler, former CEO of ⁠building group Balfour Beatty (BALF.L)
, opens new tab
, ​as its permanent chairman, it ​said on Wednesday, having fired Albert Manifold in May after less than ​a year in the position, citing ​governance and conduct concerns.
Board member Amanda Blanc ‌who ⁠oversaw both Manifold's and Tyler's appointments will not seek re-election at next year's ​annual general ​meeting ⁠and will step down once a successor ​for her has been ​found, ⁠BP said.
